You gain the following Channel the Force option.

Disarming Slash. When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you may spend a use of Channel the Force (no action required) to try to disarm it, forcing it to drop one item you choose that it's holding. The creature makes a Strength saving throw against your universal force save DC; on a failure it drops the chosen object. If you're within 5 feet of the target and have a free hand, you may catch the item — otherwise it falls at the target's feet.
